purpose: General principles for writing design documents when no project rules exist: definition, prohibited content, quantitative goals, judgment criteria, hierarchy, architecture norms, maintenance, and a severity catalog.
summary: Definition of a design document: responsibility (How), what it excludes, lifetime, revision
Prohibited content: bulk source code, unjustified tech choices, unrequired features, guaranteed numeric goals
Handling of quantitative goals in design documents
Judgment criterion: can an implementer implement from this
Hierarchical splitting, optional sections, and Mermaid diagram guidelines
No history sections; design maintenance and update rules
Norms for dependency direction, cohesion, and SPOF/availability with gray zones
Severity catalog for violations including deliverables and frontmatter
tasks: Updating a design after implementation changes
Splitting a large design into hierarchy
title: 設計書 作成原則
